selection_evidence.clock_command: python datetime.now(timezone.utc); ZoneInfo('America/Los_Angeles') conversion; terminal tool exit 0
selection_evidence.selection_basis: Parent-agent-selected fixed future week under operator-approved holdout separation in principle; exact dates were not selected or requested directly by the operator. Dates still future at selection. Conservative collection reservation only, not sufficiency guarantee. Legacy requested_local_start, requested_local_end and requested_dates_changed fields refer to the parent agent's bounded task, not direct operator date instructions.
selection_evidence.custody_limit: Tool-observed host clock and local preregistration, not independently signed timestamp or deployed collector custody.

routing_rules.source_neutral: Protect the fixed dates across every future supported capture source; resolve actual exact source identifiers from acquisition metadata when known, never preinvent identifiers.
routing_rules.clocks: Require exact nonnegative integer UTC ms event, availability, capture and collection-start timestamps; event <= availability <= capture; selection < collection-start <= capture. Event/availability/capture all in half-open reserved window. Unknown or inconsistent => QUARANTINED.
routing_rules.intervals: For explicit intervals require known inclusive first and last dependency timestamps, containing event, wholly within window; crossing or touching exclusive end => QUARANTINED. Omitted interval means point record only.
routing_rules.exposure: All historical/observed Megga remains exposed DEVELOPMENT in v2. Known exposed source, affirmative exposure, or unknown exposure in reservation routing => QUARANTINED; no pristine reclassification. v2 exposure inventory is not exhaustive.
routing_rules.outside: Reservation returns QUARANTINED outside the fixed window, not automatic DEVELOPMENT, calibration, validation or challenge; no rolling partition shift.
routing_rules.ancestry: Existing dependencies.parent_closure plus EvaluationBoundary.inherit resolve root and all declared transitive parents. Protected/development conflict, absent nodes/splits or cycles => QUARANTINED. Independently audit completeness of declared lineage.
routing_rules.purpose: SEALED_ECONOMICS is a prospective custody-routing restriction, not a claim of captured, pristine, admitted or evaluable data.

health_fields: collector liveness and UTC coverage intervals
disconnects, gaps, dropped records and backpressure
raw integrity, decode availability and lineage
capabilities: market tape and executable venue/account state
opportunity, portfolio, inventory and correlated context
narrative availability, media clock and identity linkage
coverage_policy.decision_rule: Retain every acquired interval and outage/gap record. Mark each capability PRESENT, PARTIAL, ABSENT or UNKNOWN from acquisition-health metadata only; never inspect returns, labels, class yield or teacher/model performance to continue, drop or replace sessions.
coverage_policy.stop_rule: Pause affected acquisition on lost source/provider authorization, approved budget uncertainty/exhaustion, custody failure or unsafe acquisition health. Quarantine unsafe records, retain prior partials and gap ledger. Resume only within original dates when the health/permission gate recovers; no compensating days or extra streams.
coverage_policy.later_sufficiency: Assess natural-prevalence economic sufficiency, full capability coverage and censoring later under independent evaluation protocol. Seven days guarantees neither sample size nor sufficiency. Insufficient/outage-rich reservation stays insufficient with original dates.
coverage_policy.challenge: Separate balanced diagnostics remain separately preregistered/unresolved; never rebalance or replace primary natural-prevalence economics.

permissions.operator_principle_evidence: north_star/EVALUATION_RESERVATION_DECISION.md records operator approval of holdout separation in principle only; the parent agent selected the exact dates in its bounded Stage1 reservation task, not by direct operator instruction.
permissions.acquisition: No collection or spending is granted. Use existing pipeline only after separately verified exact source/provider, rights and budget approvals; metadata support flag is not approval.

immutability.digest: SHA256 UTF-8 sorted-key compact JSON, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, excluding reservation_sha256 field
immutability.pin: Separately pin reservation_sha256 from EVAL_RESERVATION_V3.md and receipt before use; do not trust a recomputed self-hash alone.
immutability.version_rule: Do not overwrite exercised reservation v3 or edit its dates. Changes require a separate version and explicit invalidation/assessment, never replacement selected on observed outcomes.
immutability.base_freeze: Additive only; EVAL_FREEZE.json v2 bytes and pending fit gate remain unchanged.
